newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yamaichi Sec to give 150 bln yen aid to group firm.
newsitem.headline: Yamaichi Sec to give 150 bln yen aid to group firm.

text.p: Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd said on Wednesday that it would provide 150 billion yen in financial support to Yamaichi Finance, one of its group companies.
A spokesman for Yamaichi Securities said the brokerage would hold a news conference at 0630 GMT on the planned financial support and on a revision of Yamaichi Securities's earnings forecast.
The securities house is one of Japan's "Big Four" brokerages.
The spokesman declined to provide any more details on the the financial support and the revised earnings forecast.

The Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said in its evening edition on Wednesday that as a result of the financial support, Yamaichi Securities would suffer a net loss of 100-110 billion yen in the year to March 31, 1997.

Yamaichi Finance, which mainly lends to real estate firms, plans to write off all its bad loans in three years, the newspaper said. Yamaichi Finance will receive 100 billion yen from Yamaichi Securities and borrow 50 billion yen at low interest rates, it said.
Yamaichi Finance has total assets worth 360 billion yen, of which 140 billion yen are irrecoverable loans, it said.
